value.rationale: The natural 60 Göpel and 80 Rosenhain arithmetic parameter schemes jointly have complete zeta functions reconstructed from only two base-field integers. Their unique persistent ambiguity is realized in every odd finite field, and they distinguish a branch partition pair invisible to both separate node and trope spectra. This provides a sharp and motivated arithmetic-information boundary rather than a table-only exercise.
